query: The (MnNiSi)0.62(FeCoGe)0.38 high-entropy alloy is a solid refrigeration working medium that exhibits a large caloric response under applied-field and pressure-field operation but has poor load-bearing integrity and tends to crack. What single intervention could increase its integrity while preserving caloric performance in these operating regimes? State one hypothesis specifying the intervention, its proposed mechanism, predicted integrity and caloric outcomes relative to the unchanged alloy, applicable field, pressure, temperature, and loading boundaries, supporting prior evidence, and a controlled experiment with explicit results that would falsify the hypothesis.

generation.hypothesis: Introducing a heterogeneous grain structure with 3D twin architectures in the (MnNiSi)0.62(FeCoGe)0.38 high-entropy alloy will increase its load-bearing integrity by 25% while preserving its caloric performance under applied-field and pressure-field operation.
generation.intervention: Introduction of heterogeneous grain structure with 3D twin architectures through controlled thermomechanical processing
generation.conditions: Applied-field: 0-5 Tesla, Pressure-field: 0-100 MPa, Temperature: 250-350 K, Loading: uniaxial tension
generation.structural_mediator: Grain boundary and twin boundary density
generation.mechanism: The introduction of heterogeneous grain structure and 3D twin architectures will enhance the alloy's resistance to cracking by providing additional pathways for stress relaxation and improving the material's ability to absorb and distribute loads
generation.predicted_outcome: 25% increase in load-bearing integrity, measured by ultimate tensile strength, and preservation of caloric performance, measured by adiabatic temperature change
generation.boundary: Applied-field: 5 Tesla, Pressure-field: 100 MPa, Temperature: 350 K, Loading: 500 MPa
generation.uncertainty: The actual increase in load-bearing integrity may vary depending on the specific processing conditions and the resulting microstructure

falsification_experiment.design: Uniaxial tensile testing and caloric performance measurement under applied-field and pressure-field operation
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the treated alloy exhibits less than 10% increase in load-bearing integrity or more than 10% decrease in caloric performance compared to the untreated alloy, the hypothesis is falsified
